sections.Profile:
"Gold Mine," released by Marvel Manufacturing Company in January 1948, is a single-player, electro-mechanical pinball machine with a mining theme. The playfield features four flippers, 13 passive bumpers, and three kick-out holes.

- Manufacturer: Marvel Manufacturing Company
- Years made: 1948
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Lights
- Players: 1
- Tags: Prospecting, Single Player, Women, Gold, Wood Rail, Original Theme
